description: Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies have permeated all aspects of society and are increasingly being used in critical applications such as healthcare and autonomous vehicles. Amidst this emerging trend, the accuracy and performance of AI systems are not the only crucial factors. As future designers of AI systems, students must carefully consider the user experience for AI to have practical value. This course will take students on an exploratory journey through human-AI interaction, covering essential topics such as ethics, explainability, the design process involving AI, and human-AI collaboration.
